content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] modules and would appreciate some guidance. I have a 4-bit binary switch connected to 4 inputs and need to generate an analog output from 0 to 10V based on the binary value (counting only up to 10). I also tried showing the resulting value on the display but only get separate messages; the binary values are not summed, and the highest priority message is shown. Sorry if this has already been covered—I couldn't figure out how to search the forum and may have missed any solutions as I went through all the pages.
Which [product_name] module are you working with?
I'm using a [article_no] 24V module with [product_name] DM16 and [product_name] AM2 AQ. Thanks.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is seeking to convert 4-bit binary inputs from switches into an analog output ranging from 0 to 10V, and to display the resulting value as a unified number on the module's display. They are struggling with the display feature, as it only presents separated messages. The community contributes sample programs, technical advice, and relevant keywords, yet the main issue of presenting the aggregated binary value on the display remains foremost.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the [product_name] module can decode combined 4-bit binary inputs and generate a corresponding analog voltage output, which should be clearly shown as a single decimal value on the display.
